summary: Frontend-only validation of the NEW DayTravelNotes 'Notas del día' swipeable carousel on /viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_6n_7d. Verified 7 day blocks, 3 notes each (tagline/title/body), Spanish content for day 1, trilingual switching (es/en/fr), CMS edit mode contenteditable surfaces, and absence on the other trip /viajes/marrakech_ergchebbi/programa_6n_7d. One minor UX issue with the dot-indicator active state when the carousel rail cannot fully scroll to the requested slide.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'next' arrow once on day 1 (desktop, 1920px) did NOT advance the active dot from 0->1, although the rail visually scrolled and notes 2 & 3 became visible. Subsequently clicking dot index 2 settled the active state on index 1 (not 2). Root cause: the lg:col-span-6 column is narrower than 3*280px=840px so the rail can scroll but the requested slide may not reach the left edge; the `onScroll` handler then re-derives `active` from the nearest child to `scrollLeft+offsetLeft` and overrides the `setActive(idx)` call from `goTo`. Pure UX/polish issue; navigation still works visually and arrows/dots are clickable.

action_items: LOW PRIORITY UX POLISH: In DayTravelNotes.jsx, the `onScroll` callback re-derives `active` from scrollLeft and can override `goTo`'s setActive when the rail cannot fully position the requested slide at offsetLeft 0. Two possible fixes: (a) debounce/suppress onScroll updates for ~400ms after a goTo programmatic scroll, OR (b) compute `nearest` against the centre of the viewport instead of the left edge so that the currently centred snap-child is reported. This is purely cosmetic — visual scrolling and snapping already work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: DayTravelNotes.jsx (193 lines) — clean, well-scoped component. Uses unique slot namespace `program.${routeId}.day.${dayIndex}.note.${i}.{tagline|title|body}` based on 1-based day index so edits cannot leak across days even when two days in a trip share the same dayId (mirrors the index-based fix applied to galleries in iteration 34). Good.
Gating via getDayTravelNotes(routeId, dayIndex) → returns null if not configured, so component returns null. Verified negative case on marrakech_ergchebbi trip (0 blocks).

onScroll handler at line 113-123 calls setActive on every scroll event including during smooth-scroll animations triggered by goTo; this races with goTo's own setActive(idx) and produces the dot-desync observed. Consider a flag like `isProgrammaticScroll` set inside goTo and cleared after ~400ms.
All interactive elements have proper data-testid (prev/next buttons, dots, track, individual notes, edit text slots). Excellent testability.
Trilingual content via pick(COPY.eyebrow, lang) + EditableText defaults={note.tagline} (objects {es,en,fr}) — works correctly across all 3 languages.

context_for_next_testing_agent: DayTravelNotes feature is functionally COMPLETE on tourAtlasDesierto67. The 7 day blocks have heterogeneous dayId slugs (dia-1, dia-atlas-mgoun, dia-dades-todra, dia-2, dia-3, dia-4-rissani, dia-ziz-return) — do NOT assume 'dia-1..dia-7'. Use [data-testid^='day-travel-notes-'] to enumerate. Slot keying uses 1-based dayIndex, not dayId. Language switcher lives in Footer.jsx with data-testid='footer-lang-button-{es|en|fr}'. The only outstanding issue is a minor dot-indicator sync glitch (LOW priority) inside DayTravelNotes.jsx onScroll handler.
rca of the issue: Dot indicator desync RCA: In DayTravelNotes.jsx, goTo(idx) calls el.scrollTo({left: slide.offsetLeft - el.offsetLeft, behavior:'smooth'}) AND setActive(idx). During the smooth-scroll animation, onScroll fires many times and recomputes active via Math.abs(child.offsetLeft - el.offsetLeft - el.scrollLeft). On a rail that cannot scroll as far as the requested slide's offset (e.g. last slide when rail width > viewport), the final settled scrollLeft is at max-scroll which corresponds to a slide index LOWER than the requested one, so setActive lands on (n-1) instead of (n). On the first 'next' click the smooth-scroll briefly reaches scrollLeft near slide 1 then snaps back near slide 0 due to snap-mandatory + insufficient overflow, leaving active=0. Mitigation: gate onScroll updates with a programmatic-scroll flag for ~400ms after goTo, or compute nearest from the rail's viewport centre instead of left edge.
